fukuoka-canal-city-hakata.name: Canal City Hakata
fukuoka-canal-city-hakata.hours: 10:00-21:00 (restaurants until 23:00; varies by shop); fountain shows every 30 min 10:00-22:00
fukuoka-canal-city-hakata.address_local: 〒812-0018 福岡県福岡市博多区祇園町

fukuoka-castle-ruins.name: Fukuoka Castle Ruins (Maizuru Park)
fukuoka-castle-ruins.best_season: late March to early April (cherry blossoms)
fukuoka-castle-ruins.address_local: 〒300-2406 茨城県つくばみらい市箕輪国道354号旧道

fukuoka-dazaifu-tenmangu.name: Dazaifu Tenmangu Shrine
fukuoka-dazaifu-tenmangu.approx_cost: Shrine free; Dazaifu Tenmangu Museum ¥500; Kanko Historical Museum ¥200; ¥1,000 combined (both + Kyushu National Museum)
fukuoka-dazaifu-tenmangu.hours: Main hall 6:00-19:00 (Apr–May), 6:00-19:30 (Jun–Aug), 6:00-19:00 (early–mid Sep), 6:30-19:00 (late Sep–Nov), 6:30-18:30 (Dec–mid Mar), 6:00-18:30 (late Mar); museums 9:00-16:30 (entry until 16:00)
fukuoka-dazaifu-tenmangu.best_season: late February to mid March (plum blossoms)
fukuoka-dazaifu-tenmangu.address_local: 〒818-0117 福岡県太宰府市白川宰府三丁目太鼓橋

fukuoka-hakata-gion-yamakasa.name: Hakata Gion Yamakasa

editions.note: Decorative kazariyama floats displayed around Hakata 1–14 July (incl. Hakata Station and Canal City); practice runs and parades 10–14 July; main race (Oiyama) 15 July from 4:59, starting at Kushida Shrine, about 5 km course

fukuoka-hakata-gion-yamakasa.approx_cost: Free to watch along the course; paid seats in Kushida Shrine courtyard are very hard to get

fukuoka-kushida-shrine.name: Kushida Shrine
fukuoka-kushida-shrine.address_local: 〒810-0801 福岡県福岡市博多区上川端町中洲四丁目博多川端商店街

fukuoka-nakasu-yatai.name: Nakasu Yatai (Food Stalls)
fukuoka-nakasu-yatai.approx_cost: No entry fee; pay per dish/drink

closed.irregular: Each stall closes one day a week (varies, often Sunday); stalls do not open in very bad weather

fukuoka-nakasu-yatai.address_local: 〒810-0801 福岡県福岡市博多区中洲中洲二丁目錦小路

fukuoka-ohori-park.name: Ohori Park
fukuoka-ohori-park.approx_cost: Park free; Japanese Garden ¥250; Fukuoka Art Museum ¥200 (permanent exhibition)
fukuoka-ohori-park.hours: Park open access; Japanese Garden 9:00-17:00 (May–Sep until 18:00, last entry 15 min before); Fukuoka Art Museum 9:30-17:30 (Fri–Sat until 20:00 Jul–Oct, last entry 30 min before)
fukuoka-ohori-park.address_local: 〒810-0074 福岡県福岡市中央区NX福岡大手門テラス1F

fukuoka-shofukuji.name: Shofukuji Temple
fukuoka-shofukuji.hours: Always open (grounds only; buildings cannot be entered)
fukuoka-shofukuji.address_local: 〒812-0025 福岡県福岡市博多区冷泉町博多駅前二丁目大博通り

fukuoka-to-beppu.name: Fukuoka ↔ Beppu
fukuoka-to-beppu.approx_cost: Limited express Sonic Hakata–Beppu about 2h, ¥6,380 unreserved; or Shinkansen to Kokura + Sonic about 1h40, ¥6,640 unreserved (Sep 2025 figures; a 2026 page quotes ¥6,500 / about 95 min). Green car upgrade on Sonic about +¥2,270.

fukuoka-to-kagoshima.name: Fukuoka ↔ Kagoshima
fukuoka-to-kagoshima.approx_cost: Kyushu Shinkansen Hakata–Kagoshima-Chuo, Mizuho about 1h16–1h20 (Sakura slower; up to about 8 min longer since the Sep 2026 post-quake reopening). Reserved about ¥11,950 (Ekitan; ¥12,150 quoted Kagoshima-Chuo→Hakata, probably a seasonal difference); unreserved = normal reserved − ¥530. Exact post-April-2025 official fare not confirmed.

fukuoka-to-kumamoto.name: Fukuoka ↔ Kumamoto
fukuoka-to-kumamoto.approx_cost: Kyushu Shinkansen Hakata–Kumamoto (Mizuho/Sakura/Tsubame), about 32–38 min (up to about 8 min longer on some trains since the 18 Sep 2026 post-quake reopening): unreserved ¥5,310, reserved ¥5,840 (normal season; ±¥200 off-peak/peak; one travel site shows ¥6,040). Kyushu Net Hayatoku 7 online discount ¥3,800–4,800.

fukuoka-to-nagasaki.name: Fukuoka ↔ Nagasaki
fukuoka-to-nagasaki.approx_cost: Hakata–Nagasaki by Relay Kamome + Nishi-Kyushu Shinkansen Kamome (transfer at Takeo-Onsen, same platform): fastest about 1h20. Unreserved ¥5,960, reserved ¥6,490 (Nov 2026 guide); JR online 7-day-advance tickets about ¥3,400. Reserved seats cost ¥200 less in the off-peak season and ¥200–400 more in peak seasons.

fukuoka-tower-momochi.name: Fukuoka Tower and Seaside Momochi
fukuoka-tower-momochi.approx_cost: Fukuoka Tower ¥800; Momochihama beach free; Fukuoka City Museum ¥200 (permanent exhibition)
fukuoka-tower-momochi.hours: Fukuoka Tower 9:30-22:00 (entry until 21:30); Fukuoka City Museum 9:30-17:30 (entry until 17:00)

closed.irregular: Fukuoka Tower closed the last Monday and Tuesday of June

fukuoka-tower-momochi.name_local: 福岡タワー・シーサイドももち
fukuoka-tower-momochi.address_local: 〒814-0001 福岡県福岡市早良区百道浜二丁目26

osaka-to-fukuoka.name: Osaka ↔ Fukuoka
osaka-to-fukuoka.approx_cost: Sanyo Shinkansen Shin-Osaka–Hakata: Nozomi/Mizuho about 2h21–2h28, Sakura/Hikari about 2h36. 2026 fares: unreserved ¥14,750 (all trains, all year); reserved Nozomi/Mizuho ¥16,020 in the normal season (+¥200–400 peak, −¥200 off-peak). Nozomi/Mizuho need a supplement with the Japan Rail Pass.

tokyo-to-fukuoka.name: Tokyo ↔ Fukuoka
tokyo-to-fukuoka.approx_cost: Haneda (some Narita)–Fukuoka, about 110 min flight (about 4 h door to door). LCC (Peach, Jetstar Japan, Skymark) about ¥5,000–25,000; JAL/ANA/Starflyer discount fares ¥16,000–35,000, regular about ¥45,000. Lowest fares seen for Nov–Dec 2026: Peach ¥6,487, Jetstar ¥6,488, Starflyer ¥11,590, Skymark ¥11,760, JAL ¥15,084, ANA ¥15,540. Alternative: Nozomi shinkansen about 5 h, around ¥23,000.
